title: ze_skygarden
description:
地图作者:气流
本地图为20~24分钟流程 有三种zm神器 八种人类神器
背景故事:古代瘟疫爆发了,受感染的不死生物只能通过天空塔的天之穹树得到净化,然而，圣树需要能量来释放净化魔法,我们需要去远古之地获取水晶能量的核心,来为圣树补充能量.一场史诗般的冒险开始了……
本地图需要在有cs2fix插件游玩
=----------------------------------------------=
Mapper:气流
It takes about 20~24 minutes to complete all levels of this map. Map contains 3 zombie items and 8 human items.
Background Story: Once a day an ancient plague broke out, The only way to purify the infected undead is the skytree on the skytower. However, the sacred tree needs to energy to cast purification magic, thus we need to get the crystal energy core in the temple as the supply of the energy for the tree.So begins the epic adventure……
